mapper.select: select count(settlement_status) from team_settlement where settlement_status = '정산대기'
select sum(amount) from team_settlement where settlement_status = '정산대기'

select m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from team_settlement s join team_match m on s.team_match_id = m.team_match_id where s.settlement_status = '정산대기' order by match_date desc

select m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from team_settlement s join team_match m on s.team_match_id = m.team_match_id and s.settlement_status = '지급완료' order by match_date desc

select m.team_match_id as matchId, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from team_settlement s join team_match m on s.team_match_id = m.team_match_id where m.match_date = #{targetDate} order by m.match_date desc
